blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—DMD Construction, DC Abay-Abay, and Penrex Suns opened the inaugural season of the Nevermind Basketball Club (NBC), a new addition to Cebu’s basketball scene, winning their opening-day games at the Subangdaku Gymnasium over the weekend. DMD Construction made the biggest offensive statement. They overwhelmed All Out Squad, 94-70 to kick off their campaign with a 24-point victory. Ranel Cortes spearheaded DMD Construction’s offensive assault with 26 points. That was the highest individual scoring output among the three winning teams on opening day.
